goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche gesellschaftliche Gruppenperspektiven darstellen (z.B. Jugend, Zuwanderung, Geschlechterrollen).
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three equally dignified people compare learning, access/work and family/care needs over the same town model. The shared setting and different lenses introduce perspectives without ranking a group, defining everyone in a demographic group by one interest or inventing measured preferences.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px all three people, lens headings, large need symbols and shared town remain recognizable; small town details are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px learning, accessible travel/work and family/care considerations are clear over the common model.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: All three actors look toward their lenses and shared physical town model correctly; the lenses contain illustrative icons rather than reversed documents.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The selected individuals illustrate possible perspectives, not typical opinions of all young, migrant, older or gender groups.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
